_comment: WSF Pipeline Configuration — edit paths before running

step1_wsf_opl._comment_sdr_sources: Folders with resampled SDR files (*WSFM_01_d<date>*_res_sdr.nc), in reading order. layout = sub-folder holding one day, with {yyyy} {mm} {dd} {yyyymm} {yyyymmdd}. Each pass (start time) is read in its newest processing version (_vNNNN_) found in any folder; if several folders have that version, the first one listed wins.
step1_wsf_opl._comment_skip_file_prefixes: Files whose names start with these are ignored (e.g. unfinished transfers).
step1_wsf_opl._comment_staging_dir: Per-hour folders of links to the chosen files; LDT reads these. Each is removed after its hour.

step2_prediction._comment_blending: How each cell combines the Random Forests of its top_k nearest environmental clusters: SM = sum_k w_k * RF_k(TB). distance = weights from the distance to the KMeans cluster centres (see temperature); hard = the cell's own cluster only (w = 1); gmm = Gaussian-mixture probabilities (nearly hard, and its top cluster can differ from the cluster the cell was trained in).
step2_prediction._comment_top_k: Number of nearest clusters whose Random Forests are combined (1 with hard).
step2_prediction._comment_temperature: Used with distance only. d_k = Euclidean distance between the cell's encoded static features (land-cover and climate flags, standardised clay/sand/silt) and cluster centre k. Weight w_k = exp(-d_k / T) / sum_j exp(-d_j / T), j over the top_k nearest clusters. Smaller T = sharper: the nearest cluster dominates and only cells between clusters blend (T -> 0 is hard). Larger T = more mixing (weights approach 1/top_k). Example d = 1.0 and 1.5: T = 1 gives 0.62/0.38, T = 0.2 gives 0.92/0.08, T = 0.1 gives 0.99/0.01.
